File Converter · free, in your browser

A free CloudConvert alternative that stays on your device

File Converter does everyday conversions in a browser tab, without sending your files anywhere: pictures, PDFs, video, sound, spreadsheets, contacts, calendars and text.

Open File Converter

How to do it

  1. Open File Converter and drop one file or many.
  2. Pick the format you want from the list of conversions those files allow.
  3. Set the options, such as quality, size or page range.
  4. Choose Convert, then download each file or everything as a ZIP.

Among the conversions: PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, ICO and PDF for pictures; PDF to images, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or HTML; merging and splitting PDFs; MOV to MP4, video to GIF, MP3 or WAV; CSV, JSON, XLSX and vCard; e-mail, calendar and XML files; Base64 and URL encoding; and ZIP files.

Your files stay on this device: File Converter runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is File Converter part of CloudConvert?

No. ITpris Verktyg is not affiliated with CloudConvert. CloudConvert is a trademark of its owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

Are my files uploaded?

No. Every conversion runs in your browser, including video through a copy of ffmpeg that runs on your device.

Is there a limit on files?

There is no account or quota. Large videos are limited only by your device's memory and speed.

Do I need to sign up?

No. Open the page and drop your files; nothing asks for an account or an e-mail address.
